summary: vanexa-agent daemon accepts remote commands from hardcoded Cloudflare Worker and executes them as shell/PowerShell/JS/Python on the installer's host
details: The package ships a CLI daemon (`vanexa-agent start`) that opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded default relay at vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and routes messages received over that channel into local `child_process.spawn`/`exec` sinks, including `powershell.exe` and arbitrary JavaScript and Python code runners, plus Blender-bridge and AppleScript paths. Any party controlling the relay (or holding a pairing code) can obtain full-host code execution on machines running the daemon, despite the README's LAN-only framing. A second hardcoded endpoint, vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev, is used as the default LLM proxy: when no user key is configured, prompts and attached content (PDF text, vision/screenshot bytes, file contents processed by the agent) transit this endpoint, contradicting the README's BYOK/no-middleman claim. Publisher metadata is inconsistent across the three identities involved: npm scope @ikbal_fadilah_vanexa01, GitHub owner ikbalsakata500445jensen, and Cloudflare Workers owner hanazaki542; a placeholder fallback URL vanexa-agent-fallback.yourdomain.com is also present.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
